description: Lists your recent separations, newest first, 30 per page (GET /stem-tool/jobs). Use it to find a job id again, or to see whether one is still running before starting another (only one can run at a time). Pass the returned "next" as "before" for the next page. Costs no quota (read rate limit).

before.description: Cursor: the "next" value of the previous page.

name: jj_stems_list_jobs
title: List recent stem separations
